The draw for the fixtures was held on 20 June 2013.{{cite web|title=PSL Fixtures Announced|url=http://www.soccerladuma.co.za/news/article/south-africa/psl-fixtures-announced|publisher=Soccer Laduma|access-date=2 August 2013|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20130625081359/http://www.soccerladuma.co.za/news/article/south-africa/psl-fixtures-announced|archive-date=25 June 2013|url-status=dead|df=dmy-all}} The season was scheduled to begin on 2 August 2013 and end on 10 May 2014. [[Kaizer Chiefs F.C.|Kaizer Chiefs]] were the defending champions, having won the previous [[2012–13 Premier Soccer League]] (PSL) season. The season featured 14 teams from the 2012-13 season and two new teams promoted from the [[2012–13 National First Division]]: [[Polokwane City F.C.|Polokwane City]] and [[Mpumalanga Black Aces F.C.|Mpumalanga Black Aces]] who replace relegated [[Black Leopards F.C.|Black Leopards]] and [[Chippa United F.C.|Chippa United]]. ==Average attendance== {| class="wikitable sortable" |- !
